title: Mock Test

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.
He behaved ruthlessly with his junior, to say the least
questions.solution:
B) Ruthlessly(adverb) – Without pity or compassion for others; cruelly, mercilessly, brutally. निर्मम ढंग से
Synonym:Inhumanly(adverb) – In a manner lacking human qualities of compassion and mercy; cruelly, mercilessly. अमानवीय ढंग से

questions.question:
Select the option that is similar in meaning to the underlined word in the following sentence.
A good critic should also be a person of great candour
questions.solution:
C)Candour(noun) – The quality of being open and honest; frankness. ईमानदारी
Synonym:Honesty(noun) – The quality of being truthful and sincere. ईमानदारी

questions.question:

questions.question:

questions.question:

questions.question:

questions.question:
